comparison.objective: Select the two 8 cm spacers by ruler measurement and place only those in a kit cup; candidate fractures and recovers four installed HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual measurement, part selection, and pick-and-place versus coaxial mandrel alignment, bimanual hammer impact, fracture control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly both 8 cm spacers and nothing else in the cup versus four contact-driven notch fractures, all tangs contained, and no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities and outcomes differ materially. The record supplies a binary kit criterion but no placement tolerances.
